statCard.description: The workhorse metric card: a headline aggregate with an optional trend pill and mini sparkline.

usageMeter.description: Quota consumption against a limit; the bar turns amber, then red, past your thresholds.

statTileCompact.description: A slim metric tile with a micro-label, trend chip, and 6-bar spark — for dense rows of 4 to 6.

metricHero.description: One oversized metric that counts up on load, with a trend pill, spark, and goal progress.

statPairCard.description: Two metrics side by side; the second can be derived from the first.

gaugeRing.description: A ring gauge for a score or percentage, tinted by the band the value falls in.

gaugeArc.description: A speedometer arc with qualitative bands and a needle; also renders a grid of gauges.

toastStack.description: The overlay toast host: brief confirmations with an optional Undo.
